    {
      "id": "WLOG04",
      "title": "Offline domain logon: cached local verifier, no fresh KDC grant",
      "goal": "Demonstrate a previously signed-in domain user entering a disconnected desktop and distinguish cached validation from fresh domain authentication and network credentials.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: user",
        "L: Winlogon/LogonUI and credential provider",
        "A: LSA/LSASS authentication and policy role",
        "P: user process/session and kernel token role",
        "C: protected local cached-domain-logon store",
        "K: unavailable domain controller"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Domain member with a prior successful online password sign-in for CORP\\alice and an explicitly enabled cache policy.",
        "DC is unreachable, not actively rejecting the presented credential; user is not Protected Users.",
        "New boot/session fixture has no reusable live TGT; model cached verifier symbolically, not as a recoverable password or pass-the-hash credential."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "attempt",
          "from": "L",
          "to": "A",
          "type": "local-call",
          "action": "Submit domain-scoped input; establish that the selected online authority is unavailable.",
          "artifacts": [
            "logon-request",
            "availability-result"
          ],
          "boundary": "Timeout/unreachable result is not an account-validation response."
        },
        {
          "id": "cache-policy",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "C",
          "type": "local-check",
          "action": "Check cache policy and locate this user prior verifier/account-information entry.",
          "artifacts": [
            "cache-policy",
            "cached-verifier",
            "cached-account-data"
          ],
          "boundary": "Cache availability is explicit preexisting state."
        },
        {
          "id": "verify",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "A",
          "type": "local-verify",
          "action": "Validate current input locally against the cached verifier.",
          "artifacts": [
            "cached-validation-result"
          ],
          "boundary": "No KDC learns or grants anything."
        },
        {
          "id": "session",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "P",
          "type": "local-create",
          "action": "Apply effective local logon policy and create the locally authorized token/desktop using the declared cached identity snapshot.",
          "artifacts": [
            "cached-identity-snapshot",
            "primary-token",
            "desktop"
          ],
          "boundary": "Offline success cannot imply fresh remote group/account-state knowledge."
        },
        {
          "id": "resource",
          "from": "P",
          "to": "P",
          "type": "teaching-link",
          "action": "Show later network authentication as a separate attempt that still needs a reachable authority/valid usable credential.",
          "artifacts": [
            "network-attempt-state"
          ],
          "boundary": "The cache entry itself is never a wire credential."
        }
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        {
          "id": "no-cache",
          "detector": "C",
          "condition": "First use of this domain account, entry evicted, or cache disabled",
          "stopBoundary": "cache-policy",
          "preserved": "No offline desktop."
        },
        {
          "id": "cache-mismatch",
          "detector": "A",
          "condition": "Input does not match the existing verifier",
          "stopBoundary": "verify",
          "preserved": "No success."
        },
        {
          "id": "protected-user",
          "detector": "C",
          "condition": "Protected Users rules prevented cache-verifier creation",
          "stopBoundary": "cache-policy",
          "preserved": "Explain policy reason without changing the account policy."
        },
        {
          "id": "online-rejection",
          "detector": "K",
          "condition": "DC reachable and rejects this credential/account",
          "stopBoundary": "attempt",
          "preserved": "Do not bypass the rejection with a stale cache."
        },
        {
          "id": "stale-password-or-disable",
          "detector": "A",
          "condition": "DC-side change is unknown offline",
          "stopBoundary": "session",
          "preserved": "Label local/stale verification explicitly; no claim of fresh domain approval."
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Wire inventory contains no transmitted cache verifier, password derived from cache, fresh AS-REP or fresh domain status.",
        "Positive offline case has zero new KDC-issued tickets.",
        "Preserve the difference between new input credentials, cached verifier and any later LSA credential handle.",
        "Cite/pin cache and Protected Users policy instead of teaching cached logon as universally available."
      ],
      "heldArtifacts": [
        "cache policy/verifier/account snapshot",
        "availability result",
        "local validation",
        "local token/session",
        "network-attempt placeholder"
      ],
      "crossLinks": [

        "WLOG07"
      ],

    {
      "id": "WLOG05",
      "title": "Smart-card domain sign-in: local PIN and PKINIT to desktop",
      "goal": "Connect card-local private-key authorization to PKINIT, current certificate mapping, a local workstation ticket and Windows session creation.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: user",
        "L: Winlogon/LogonUI and credential provider",
        "A: LSA/LSASS authentication and policy role",
        "P: user process/session and kernel token role",
        "T: smart card and CSP/KSP role",
        "K: ADDS KDC",
        "M: workstation Kerberos acceptor"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Domain member; provisioned nonexportable card key/certificate, KDC certificate/trust and strong account binding.",
        "Use accepted AD03 fresh-DH reference; pin current MS-PKCA24.0 Windows algorithm/freshness profile before product-specific claims.",
        "Certificate provisioning is preexisting; online CA issuance is not a login message."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "select",
          "from": "U",
          "to": "L",
          "type": "local-input",
          "action": "Select a permitted certificate tile; collect PIN into the protected local credential pipeline.",
          "artifacts": [
            "certificate",
            "protected-PIN-input",
            "card-key-handle"
          ],
          "boundary": "PIN is not an AD password or KDC padata value."
        },
        {
          "id": "sign",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "T",
          "type": "local-call",
          "action": "Authorize the card operation and sign the PKINIT request with the card-resident key.",
          "artifacts": [
            "signed-AuthPack",
            "card-key-handle"
          ],
          "boundary": "Only signature/public certificate leave the card boundary."
        },
        {
          "id": "pkinit",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "K",
          "type": "network-exchange",
          "action": "Reuse the accepted PKINIT request/DH reply sequence and current certificate-chain, EKU, revocation and strong mapping checks.",
          "artifacts": [
            "PA-PK-AS-REQ",
            "PA-PK-AS-REP",
            "DH/reply-key-context"
          ],
          "boundary": "UPN-only weak mapping is not the modern happy path."

    {
      "id": "WLOG06",
      "title": "Domain password sign-in with required FAST armor",
      "goal": "Make computer authentication, user authentication and local Windows session creation separate stages when Kerberos armoring is required.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: user",
        "L: Winlogon/LogonUI and credential provider",
        "A: LSA/LSASS authentication and policy role",
        "P: user process/session and kernel token role",
        "M: machine Kerberos credential context",
        "K: FAST-capable ADDS KDC"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Domain member; client armoring enabled, RequireFAST=true, compatible realm/DC and usable computer TGT.",
        "Use accepted AD04 PA-ENCRYPTED-CHALLENGE and reply-strengthening model; user and computer identities/keys differ."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "armor-ready",
          "from": "M",
          "to": "M",
          "type": "local-check",
          "action": "Validate machine armor credential availability, realm capability and selected client/KDC policy.",
          "artifacts": [
            "computer-TGT",
            "computer-session-key",
            "FAST-policy"
          ],
          "boundary": "A machine TGT is not Alice authentication."
        },
        {
          "id": "user-request",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "K",
          "type": "network-exchange",
          "action": "Reuse AD04 explicit-armored user AS request with protected challenge and request checksum.",
          "artifacts": [
            "armor-AP-REQ",
            "armor-key",
            "FAST-request",
            "user-challenge"
          ],
          "boundary": "No substitution of armor key for user long-term key."
        },
        {
          "id": "kdc",
          "from": "K",
          "to": "K",
          "type": "local-verify",
          "action": "Verify armor and inner user authentication separately, then form protected response and required strengthened reply key.",
          "artifacts": [
            "FAST-reply",
            "strengthen-key",
            "user-TGT"
          ],
          "boundary": "Armor acceptance alone does not issue a user credential."
        },
        {
          "id": "accept",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "A",
          "type": "local-verify",
          "action": "Validate finished/bindings and decrypt the AS reply before installing the user TGT/key.",
          "artifacts": [
            "accepted-user-TGT"
          ],
          "boundary": "Receipt/unwrap/acceptance remain explicit."
        },
        {
          "id": "desktop",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "P",
          "type": "teaching-macro",
          "action": "Continue host-workstation TGS/local validation and policy/token stages from WLOG02.",
          "artifacts": [
            "host-ticket",
            "logon-data",
            "token/session"
          ],
          "boundary": "FAST protects AS/TGS, not every subsequent application message."
        }
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        {
          "id": "armor-missing",
          "detector": "M/A",
          "condition": "Required computer TGT unavailable",
          "stopBoundary": "armor-ready",
          "preserved": "No user TGT or unadvertised unarmored fallback."
        },
        {
          "id": "realm-or-dc-unsupported",
          "detector": "A",
          "condition": "Required support absent",
          "stopBoundary": "armor-ready",
          "preserved": "Fail required profile; optional fallback belongs to named AD04 variant."
        },
        {
          "id": "tampered-fast",
          "detector": "K/A",
          "condition": "Bad armor/checksum/protected response",
          "stopBoundary": "kdc or accept",
          "preserved": "No usable user credential."
        },
        {
          "id": "bad-user-proof",
          "detector": "K",
          "condition": "Valid armor but user authentication fails",
          "stopBoundary": "kdc",
          "preserved": "Machine identity acceptance preserved, user denied."
        },
        {
          "id": "bootstrap",
          "detector": "M",
          "condition": "Machine has no TGT",
          "stopBoundary": "armor-ready",
          "preserved": "Link existing computer-bootstrap exception; do not demand machine armor recursively."
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Reuse exact AD04 operation/key history and its corrected reply strengthening.",
        "Separate machine TGT, armor key, user long-term key, strengthened reply key and issued user TGT key.",
        "Profile explains why required FAST differs from opportunistic fallback."
      ],
      "heldArtifacts": [
        "machine credential",
        "armoring policy/support evidence",
        "armor key",
        "protected challenge",
        "strengthen/reply keys",
        "user TGT",
        "local token"
      ],
      "crossLinks": [
        "lab-ad-fast-as-success",
        "lab-ad-fast-as-bootstrap",
        "lab-ad-fast-as-optional-fallback",
        "WLOG02"
      ],

    {
      "id": "WLOG07",
      "title": "Unlock an existing Windows session: local and domain policy branches",
      "goal": "Show reauthentication to unlock an existing desktop without turning lock/unlock into logoff/new-session creation.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: user",
        "L: Winlogon/LogonUI and credential provider",
        "A: LSA/LSASS authentication and policy role",
        "P: user process/session and kernel token role",
        "C: local unlock/cached validation role",
        "K: domain controller when required"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "An existing workstation session, processes, token handles and locked desktop are seeded.",
        "Base: local password account. Named domain profiles pin both RequireDomainControllerAuthenticationToUnlock and cache policy."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "lock",
          "from": "P",
          "to": "L",
          "type": "local-state",
          "action": "Lock interactive access while retaining the existing processes/session and token identities.",
          "artifacts": [
            "locked-session",
            "existing-token"
          ],
          "boundary": "Lock is not logoff or token destruction."
        },
        {
          "id": "input",
          "from": "U",
          "to": "L",
          "type": "local-input",
          "action": "Collect credential for the locked-session identity and dispatch the declared unlock path.",
          "artifacts": [
            "unlock-request"
          ],
          "boundary": "A different user belongs to switch-user/new logon, not this unlock."
        },
        {
          "id": "policy",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "A",
          "type": "local-check",
          "action": "Select local validation, domain cached validation or required DC reauthentication from explicit policy.",
          "artifacts": [
            "unlock-policy",
            "cache-policy"
          ],
          "boundary": "UI shows what authority is actually consulted."
        },
        {
          "id": "verify",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "C/K",
          "type": "local-or-network",
          "action": "Perform only the selected verification branch; label cached facts as potentially stale.",
          "artifacts": [
            "unlock-validation-result"
          ],
          "boundary": "An unavailable DC cannot magically return authentication success."
        },
        {
          "id": "resume",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "P",
          "type": "local-state",
          "action": "Permit access to the same session after successful verification; release attempt input.",
          "artifacts": [
            "existing-session-reference",
            "input-cleanup"
          ],
          "boundary": "Desktop identity and prior process token handles remain attributable."
        }
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        {
          "id": "bad-credential",
          "detector": "C/K",
          "condition": "Selected verifier rejects input",
          "stopBoundary": "verify",
          "preserved": "Session stays locked; existing processes/tokens remain."
        },
        {
          "id": "required-dc-unavailable",
          "detector": "A",
          "condition": "Require DC enabled and selected cache policy disallows local substitute",
          "stopBoundary": "verify",
          "preserved": "Stay locked."
        },
        {
          "id": "cached-domain-change",
          "detector": "C",
          "condition": "Domain disable/group change not observed by cached unlock",
          "stopBoundary": "verify",
          "preserved": "Label stale knowledge; do not refresh existing process groups from nowhere."
        },
        {
          "id": "other-user",
          "detector": "L",
          "condition": "Different identity selected",
          "stopBoundary": "input",
          "preserved": "Cross-link new logon/switch-user; never overwrite the locked session."
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Session/process/token identifiers match before lock and after successful unlock.",
        "Failed unlock changes attempt state, not existing session legitimacy.",
        "Domain-required and cached-unlock profiles have different real actor/message inventories.",
        "Do not use deprecated LogonUser LOGON32_LOGON_UNLOCK as a fabricated universal modern API sequence; use supported unlock structures/source or label internal dispatch abstract."
      ],
      "heldArtifacts": [
        "existing session/token/process references",
        "lock state",
        "unlock policy",
        "verification attempt",
        "cleanup"
      ],
      "crossLinks": [
        "WLOG01",
        "WLOG04"
      ],
      "researchGates": [
        "Offline smart-card/Hello unlock internals are not inferred; add only after credential-specific sourcing."
      ],

    {
      "id": "WLOG08",
      "title": "Nonjoined PC: domain credentials do not replace the local desktop identity",
      "goal": "Answer the workgroup-workstation question directly: local console sign-in and explicit domain access to a member-server share are different journeys.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: user",
        "L: Winlogon/LogonUI and credential provider",
        "A: LSA/LSASS authentication and policy role",
        "P: user process/session and kernel token role",
        "S: local SAM",
        "F: domain-member file server",
        "K: ADDS authority used only in the linked network flow"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "WORKGROUPPC is not joined; local bob account exists; no local alice account or preexisting domain interactive-logon relationship.",
        "Explicit domain network credentials belong to CORP\\alice; accepted SMB3.1.1 fixtures already exist."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "scope",
          "from": "U",
          "to": "L",
          "type": "local-input",
          "action": "Show machine membership and available console account authority before the attempt.",
          "artifacts": [
            "membership",
            "console-authority"
          ],
          "boundary": "Typing CORP\\alice does not join the device or provision a local principal."
        },
        {
          "id": "console-deny",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "L",

          "artifacts": [

          ],

        {

    {
      "id": "WELEV01",
      "title": "Administrator membership versus the process token actually used",
      "goal": "Explain classic UAC token filtering, group attributes, privileges and integrity before any elevation request.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: administrator user",
        "A: LSA/token policy",
        "P: Explorer and ordinary child process",
        "O: object access-check role"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Classic Admin Approval Mode explicitly selected; Administrator protection disabled for this reference.",
        "Named non-built-in administrator account, UAC enabled; SID membership and requested file operation fixed."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "token-pair",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "A",
          "type": "local-create",
          "action": "After successful sign-in, create the linked full and filtered token representations for the selected administrator.",
          "artifacts": [
            "full-token",
            "filtered-token",
            "linked-token-reference"
          ],
          "boundary": "Same account identity does not mean identical enabled groups/privileges."
        },
        {
          "id": "shell",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "P",
          "type": "local-create",
          "action": "Run Explorer and ordinary child with the filtered token at the selected medium integrity level.",
          "artifacts": [
            "process-token-reference"
          ],
          "boundary": "The full token is not the process active token."
        },
        {
          "id": "inspect",
          "from": "P",
          "to": "P",
          "type": "local-inspect",
          "action": "Compare user SID, group attributes, privileges/enabled flags, elevation type and integrity label.",
          "artifacts": [
            "token-field-view"
          ],
          "boundary": "Do not equate membership with an enabled authorization SID."
        },
        {
          "id": "access",
          "from": "P",
          "to": "O",
          "type": "local-check",
          "action": "Evaluate a declared protected operation using mandatory policy then DACL/privilege rules applicable to that operation.",
          "artifacts": [
            "object-integrity-label",
            "DACL",
            "decision"
          ],
          "boundary": "No automatic elevation merely because an operation is denied."
        }
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        {
          "id": "filtered-admin-access",
          "detector": "O",
          "condition": "Filtered token lacks effective right for selected admin operation",
          "stopBoundary": "access",
          "preserved": "Process remains unelevated."
        },
        {
          "id": "high-integrity-still-denied",
          "detector": "O",
          "condition": "Comparison full token still fails an explicit DACL",
          "stopBoundary": "access",
          "preserved": "High integrity is not blanket allow."
        },
        {
          "id": "standard-user",
          "detector": "A",
          "condition": "Account has no administrator membership",
          "stopBoundary": "token-pair",
          "preserved": "One standard token; no invented linked full token."
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Expose token differences as exact fields, including deny-only versus enabled SID attributes where pinned.",
        "Integrity check, discretionary access and privilege checks are separate concepts; do not imply a universal fixed order for every privilege-taking API.",
        "A token is an OS authorization object, not an OAuth token, password, ticket or remotely transferable credential."
      ],
      "heldArtifacts": [
        "linked token pair",
        "group attributes",
        "privilege enabled flags",
        "integrity SID",
        "DACL/mandatory policy",
        "access decision"
      ],

    {
      "id": "WELEV02",
      "title": "Run as administrator: consent for the signed-in administrator",
      "goal": "Trace an explicit elevation request through AppInfo/secure-desktop consent to a new elevated process while preserving the original process.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: signed-in administrator",
        "P: unelevated caller",
        "B: AppInfo/elevation broker",
        "L: secure-desktop consent UI",
        "E: elevated process",
        "O: protected object"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Classic Admin Approval Mode; named administrator; consent-on-secure-desktop policy; no auto-elevation case.",
        "Explicit runas shell verb/requestedExecutionLevel requiresAdministrator on a synthetic harmless helper."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "request",
          "from": "P",
          "to": "B",
          "type": "local-call",
          "action": "Submit the selected executable/requested operation with caller identity.",
          "artifacts": [
            "elevation-request",
            "executable-identity"
          ],
          "boundary": "Request is neither user approval nor process elevation."
        },
        {
          "id": "prompt",
          "from": "B",
          "to": "L",
          "type": "local-ui",
          "action": "Evaluate policy and display publisher/path/operation in the secure-desktop consent prompt.",
          "artifacts": [
            "prompt-policy",
            "consent-challenge"
          ],
          "boundary": "No credential verification is invented for a consent-only branch."
        },
        {
          "id": "consent",
          "from": "U",
          "to": "L",
          "type": "local-input",
          "action": "Approve this concrete request and return the decision to the broker.",
          "artifacts": [
            "consent-result"
          ],
          "boundary": "Consent is scoped to the pending request."
        },
        {
          "id": "launch",
          "from": "B",
          "to": "E",
          "type": "local-create",
          "action": "Create the new process with the available full administrator token at high integrity.",
          "artifacts": [
            "elevated-process",
            "full-token-reference"
          ],
          "boundary": "Do not mutate caller token or every other process."
        },
        {
          "id": "operation",
          "from": "E",
          "to": "O",
          "type": "local-check",
          "action": "Apply the selected object access/privilege check and return the real operation result.",
          "artifacts": [
            "operation-result"
          ],
          "boundary": "Elevation does not guarantee resource authorization."
        },
        {
          "id": "exit",
          "from": "E",
          "to": "E",
          "type": "local-cleanup",
          "action": "Release this process/token handle at exit; retain the signed-in session.",
          "artifacts": [
            "process-exit"
          ],
          "boundary": "No claim that classic linked admin token disappears globally."
        }
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        {
          "id": "cancel",
          "detector": "U",
          "condition": "User declines/cancels",
          "stopBoundary": "consent",
          "preserved": "No elevated process; caller survives."
        },
        {
          "id": "policy-deny",
          "detector": "B",
          "condition": "Selected elevation policy disallows request",
          "stopBoundary": "prompt",
          "preserved": "No credential or consent accepted."
        },
        {
          "id": "launch-failure",
          "detector": "B",
          "condition": "Approved executable cannot start",
          "stopBoundary": "launch",
          "preserved": "Consent history remains; no running elevated process."
        },
        {
          "id": "operation-denied",
          "detector": "O",
          "condition": "Elevated process fails the selected ACL",
          "stopBoundary": "operation",
          "preserved": "Elevation remains historically successful."
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Consented request and newly launched process are correlated.",
        "Consent-only branch has no new password, Kerberos AS or SAM verification event.",
        "Original process/session token remains unchanged through success/cancel."
      ],
      "heldArtifacts": [
        "request/policy",
        "consent prompt/result",
        "caller/full-token references",
        "new process",
        "operation result",
        "exit"
      ],

    {
      "id": "WELEV03",
      "title": "Standard-user elevation: authenticate a separate administrator",
      "goal": "Show a credential prompt as authentication of the chosen administrator and creation of that account’s elevated process, not an upgrade to the original standard-user identity.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: standard desktop user",
        "V: credential-supplying administrator",
        "P: caller process",
        "B/L: elevation broker/secure prompt",
        "A: local LSA and selected account authority",
        "E: elevated process"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Classic Admin Approval Mode; standard-user policy prompts for credentials.",
        "Base administrator is WORKSTATION\\admin2 in local SAM; separately named domain-admin-credential variant requires domain reachability and applicable local membership/rights."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "request",
          "from": "P",
          "to": "B/L",
          "type": "local-call",
          "action": "Request elevation and present an administrator credential prompt with explicit account scope.",
          "artifacts": [
            "elevation-request",
            "credential-prompt"
          ],
          "boundary": "Do not reuse standard user consent semantics."
        },
        {
          "id": "credentials",
          "from": "V",
          "to": "B/L",
          "type": "local-input",
          "action": "Supply the selected administrator credential through the secure prompt.",
          "artifacts": [
            "admin-credential-buffer"
          ],
          "boundary": "Caller does not gain readable credential contents."
        },
        {
          "id": "authenticate",
          "from": "B/L",
          "to": "A",
          "type": "local-call",
          "action": "Authenticate the selected account using its correct authority and evaluate eligibility for this elevation.",
          "artifacts": [
            "admin-validation",
            "eligibility-result"
          ],
          "boundary": "Valid nonadministrator input is not sufficient."
        },
        {
          "id": "launch",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "E",
          "type": "local-create",
          "action": "Create an elevated process for admin2 with its own token/logon context as supported by the pinned path.",
          "artifacts": [
            "admin-token",
            "new-process"
          ],
          "boundary": "Original user token/SID remains unchanged."
        },
        {
          "id": "cleanup",
          "from": "B/L",
          "to": "B/L",
          "type": "local-cleanup",
          "action": "Release temporary input and correlate successful launch or failure to the prompt.",
          "artifacts": [
            "input-cleanup",
            "launch-result"
          ],
          "boundary": "No arbitrary credential retention by caller."
        }
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        {
          "id": "wrong-admin-password",
          "detector": "A",
          "condition": "Credential invalid",
          "stopBoundary": "authenticate",
          "preserved": "No elevated process."
        },
        {
          "id": "valid-nonadmin",
          "detector": "A",
          "condition": "Valid credentials do not satisfy elevation eligibility",
          "stopBoundary": "authenticate",
          "preserved": "No grant to standard user."
        },
        {
          "id": "domain-unavailable",
          "detector": "A",
          "condition": "Selected domain credential cannot be verified under the pinned branch",
          "stopBoundary": "authenticate",
          "preserved": "Do not silently switch to a same-named local admin."
        },
        {
          "id": "auto-deny-standard-users",
          "detector": "B/L",
          "condition": "Configured policy rejects standard-user elevation",
          "stopBoundary": "request",
          "preserved": "No credential prompt/validation fabricated."
        }
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Display desktop identity and elevated-process identity simultaneously.",
        "Local and domain credential variants use different actual authorities, not a domain field on a common always-SAM event.",
        "No process exists until authentication, eligibility and process creation all succeed."
      ],
      "heldArtifacts": [
        "admin credential buffer",
        "validation/eligibility",
        "admin token",
        "caller token",
        "new process",
        "cleanup"
      ],

    {
      "id": "WELEV04",
      "title": "runas /user: secondary logon is an identity switch, not guaranteed elevation",
      "goal": "Trace a new process under another validated account while keeping UAC elevation a separate policy/launch concern.",
      "tier": "core",
      "actors": [
        "U: initiating user",
        "R: runas/Secondary Logon service role",
        "A: LSA/selected account authority",
        "P: original process",
        "Q: alternate-user process"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Pin Windows11 runas command help/API behavior; Secondary Logon available.",
        "Base alternate account WORKSTATION\\operator is nonadmin with interactive-logon permission; /netonly is absent."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "input",
          "from": "U",
          "to": "R",
          "type": "local-input",
          "action": "Choose /user:WORKSTATION\\operator and collect its password without putting a real secret in command examples.",
          "artifacts": [
            "runas-request",
            "alternate-credential"
          ],
          "boundary": "Account scope is explicit."
        },
        {
          "id": "validate",
          "from": "R",
          "to": "A",

          "action": "Authenticate the alternate account and check required logon rights.",
          "artifacts": [
            "alternate-validation",
            "rights-result"
          ],
          "boundary": "Unlike /netonly, the ordinary alternate-logon path validates before launch."
        },
        {
          "id": "profile",
          "from": "A",
          "to": "Q",
          "type": "local-create",
          "action": "Create the alternate logon context/token and load the selected /profile or /noprofile behavior.",
          "artifacts": [

            "logon-context",
            "profile-choice"

          "boundary": "Profile loading and identity are distinct."
        },
        {
          "id": "launch",
          "from": "R",
          "to": "Q",
          "type": "local-create",
          "action": "Launch the helper under the alternate token; show original P unchanged.",
          "artifacts": [
            "process-Q"
          ],
          "boundary": "A different user is not synonymous with high integrity."

        {
          "id": "compare",
          "from": "Q",

          "action": "Inspect actual integrity/token elevation state; an app needing elevation follows a separate supported UAC route.",

      "id": "LLOG01",
      "title": "Linux local workstation login through PAM",
      "goal": "Explain the local identity, authentication, account-policy and session boundaries using a declared PAM service stack.",
      "actors": [
        "Person",
        "Console login or display-manager service",
        "PAM stack",
        "Local identity/credential database",
        "Session manager/logind"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Profile L-PAM: one explicitly supplied service stack; local files identity and pam_unix password backend; no directory or KDC dependency.",
        "Select systemd session integration explicitly; do not imply every Linux login uses logind or the same stack ordering."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Resolve the entered local account to UID, GID, groups, home and shell; label this identity lookup rather than proof of identity.",
        "Start the named PAM transaction and show the conversation delivering a secret only to the selected authentication module.",
        "Evaluate configured auth-stack control flow and the credential verdict.",
        "Run account checks separately; make account expiry or access denial visible after successful authentication.",
        "Establish credentials and open the session in the application profile; show pam_systemd registration only where configured, then the resulting process identity.",
        "Close the session and PAM transaction; discard transient secret/conversation state while preserving the account record."
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        "Unknown user; incorrect password; authenticated account denied; session setup failure.",
        "A blank password is denied in the baseline. A nullok or passwordless account requires a separately labeled explicit configuration."
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Auth success alone cannot create the desktop; account and session gates must be represented.",
        "Held objects distinguish identity record, verifier, transient entered secret and session handle; the application never receives the stored password verifier as a reusable login token.",

      "id": "LLOG02",
      "title": "Linux online directory logon with SSSD and Kerberos",
      "goal": "Show how a domain identity becomes an authorized Linux session without equating directory lookup, Kerberos proof and host admission.",
      "actors": [
        "Person",
        "Login application/PAM",
        "SSSD PAM and NSS responders",
        "Directory and KDC",
        "Linux session manager"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Profile L-SSSD-AD: explicitly configured AD provider, domain enrollment/machine keytab, DNS/time/reachability, ID mapping and one access-provider policy.",
        "Use modern allowed Kerberos enctypes; share existing AD/Kerberos lessons for AS exchanges. An IPA variant must name HBAC and its own provider, not relabel AD GPO behavior."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Resolve directory user/group data through NSS and SSSD; retain the mapped UID/GIDs separately from the realm principal.",
        "Pass the PAM authentication request to SSSD; obtain/validate the Kerberos result through the selected provider.",
        "Expose a user TGT and credential cache only after an actual successful AS exchange; keep machine-account credentials separate.",
        "Evaluate the configured SSSD account/access provider for this host and PAM service.",
        "Create the local process session, credentials, home/session resources under the chosen stack.",
        "Link the existing ticket to later service-access lessons without implying login grants those resource permissions."
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        "Identity resolves but password fails; credentials succeed but host policy denies; missing UID mapping; KDC unavailable with cache disabled."
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Separate NSS/PAM responders and LDAP identity versus Kerberos authentication in the trace.",
        "Tests assert the denied account has no workstation session even when a TGT was obtained; ticket cleanup/retention follows the explicitly chosen provider policy.",
        "Record access_provider, ID-mapping mode and ccache implementation in the profile; no universal SSSD ordering or Linux-domain default."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {

      "steps": [

        "Apply the provider-specific cached account/access result; annotate that new central changes may be unknown offline.",

      "preconditions": [

        "Baseline authenticates the caller. Named alternatives rootpw, targetpw and runaspw must display the actual authenticated account."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "Capture caller UID, requested command and target identity; evaluate sudoers authorization.",
        "Determine authentication requirement from matching rule and valid timestamp scope.",

    {
      "id": "JWT01",
      "title": "JWT, JWS, JWE and opaque tokens",
      "goal": "Separate token representation from the protocol, protection and authorization decision.",
      "actors": [
        "Issuer",
        "Client",
        "Resource server"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Three fixed synthetic examples; no real credentials; compact serialization explicitly selected."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "number": 1,
          "phase": "issue",
          "action": "Create a signed three-segment JWT, encrypted five-segment JWT, and opaque reference token.",
          "heldState": "Issuer owns source claims; each output has its own exact artifact ID."
        },
        {
          "number": 2,
          "phase": "inspect",
          "action": "Let the holder decode JWS header/payload, inspect JWE envelope only, and view opaque bytes only.",
          "heldState": "Decoded JWS claims remain unverified; JWE plaintext is absent at holders without the decryption key."
        },
        {
          "number": 3,
          "phase": "validate",
          "action": "Route each artifact to its configured validation path.",
          "heldState": "Parsing creates no authenticated identity or access grant."
        },
        {
          "number": 4,
          "phase": "compare",
          "action": "Show protection and validator panels side by side.",
          "heldState": "JWT is a claims format; JWS gives integrity, JWE confidentiality/integrity; opaque is a client representation, not inherently weaker."
        }
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        "Malformed segment/base64url/JSON input produces a parse error before trust state.",
        "Do not infer token format merely from an OAuth response field name."
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Inspection never labels base64url decoding as decryption.",
        "Do not state that every JWS is a JWT, every JWT is encrypted, or JWT itself is an authentication protocol."
      ],
      "sources": [
        {
          "id": "jwt",
          "title": "RFC 7519",
          "url": "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7519.html",
          "sections": "3; 4.1; 5; 7; 11",
          "retrieved": "2026-10-21"

      "id": "JWT02",
      "title": "Signed JWT verification and tampering",

        "Bearer client",
        "API verifier"

          "number": 1,
          "phase": "issue",
          "action": "Issuer signs BASE64URL(header).BASE64URL(payload).",
          "heldState": "Private signing key remains at issuer; public verification key is verifier-local."
        },
        {
          "number": 2,
          "phase": "receive",
          "action": "API receives the exact compact token over the selected TLS carrier.",
          "heldState": "Inbox holds received bytes and untrusted decoded claims."

          "number": 3,
          "phase": "verify",
          "action": "Verify signature with configured key and algorithm.",
          "heldState": "A local signature-valid observation references the same token generation."

          "number": 4,
          "phase": "validate",
          "action": "Run issuer/audience/time/profile checks before policy.",
          "heldState": "Only all-success creates validatedClaims; access still requires separate policy."

      "negativeCases": [

      "id": "JWT06",
      "title": "JWKS rotation and bounded refresh",
      "goal": "Teach availability and key rotation without inventing an RFC-mandated cache lifetime.",
      "actors": [
        "Issuer",
        "JWKS server",
        "Verifier cache",
        "Client"
      ],
      "preconditions": [

      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "number": 1,
          "phase": "overlap",
          "action": "Publish old+new public keys before issuing tokens with new kid.",
          "heldState": "Cache initially holds old key; issuer retains both signing generations during selected overlap."
        },
        {
          "number": 2,
          "phase": "refresh",
          "action": "Receive new kid; if refresh budget allows, perform one coalesced JWKS refresh.",
          "heldState": "Pending tokens stay unaccepted; requests share refresh work."
        },
        {
          "number": 3,
          "phase": "verify",
          "action": "Find new key, verify token and claims, then accept.",
          "heldState": "Cache revision and token key generation are explicit."
        },
        {
          "number": 4,
          "phase": "retire",
          "action": "After declared lifetime/overlap, retire old key and expire cache entries.",
          "heldState": "Retirement is not instantaneous universal token revocation."
        }

      "negativeCases": [

      "actors": [
        "Alice",
        "kubectl/client-go",
        "Exec plugin + browser",
        "OIDC issuer",
        "API server",
        "RBAC",
        "Storage"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Pinned cluster fixture; exec credential API client.authentication.k8s.io/v1; public native OIDC client kubernetes-demo; authorization code + S256 PKCE; Alice sub alice and group readers."
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "number": 1,
          "phase": "login",
          "action": "kubectl calls exec plugin; plugin opens system browser at issuer and validates returned state; redeems code with verifier; validates ID token/nonce.",
          "heldState": "Plugin owns PKCE verifier/state/nonce; issuer credentials stay at issuer; refresh token remains plugin-local."
        },
        {
          "number": 2,
          "phase": "credential",
          "action": "Plugin returns ExecCredential status.token and expirationTimestamp.",
          "heldState": "kubectl obtains ID token only; API server never receives refresh token, code or PKCE verifier."
        },
        {
          "number": 3,
          "phase": "authenticate",
          "action": "kubectl sends Authorization: Bearer ID-token over TLS; API validates configured issuer/key/audience/expiry and maps identity.",
          "heldState": "API request userInfo appears only after validation; no browser redirect originates at API server."
        },
        {
          "number": 4,
          "phase": "authorize",
          "action": "GET /api/v1/namespaces/demo-dev/pods becomes list/core/pods/demo-dev; reader binding permits Alice.",
          "heldState": "Local RBAC decision records matched subject, binding and rule."
        },

      "id": "K8S03",
      "title": "Kubernetes JWT rejection and key rotation",
      "goal": "Keep failed credential validation outside RBAC and admission.",
      "actors": [

        "API JWT authenticator",
        "Issuer metadata/JWKS cache"

        {
          "number": 2,
          "phase": "verify",
          "action": "Evaluate configured issuer discovery, key/signature, audience, expiry and claim/user validation.",
          "heldState": "Record first rejecting check without exposing token secrets in logs."
        },
        {
          "number": 3,
          "phase": "rotate",
          "action": "Use old/new issuer keys to exercise cache hit and unknown-kid refresh.",
          "heldState": "No accepted identity until key resolution and verification succeed."

        {
          "number": 4,
          "phase": "reject",

          "action": "Extract list/core/pods/namespace demo-dev from the request.",
          "heldState": "Request attributes are explicit immutable input to authorization."
        },
        {
          "number": 3,
          "phase": "match",

      "id": "K8S07",

      "goal": "Prevent deny-rule and automatic-role misconceptions.",
      "actors": [

        {
          "number": 2,
          "phase": "union",
          "action": "Gather matching RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding grants applicable to request scope.",
          "heldState": "Display contributing rules; there is no RBAC deny rule overriding another grant."
        },
        {
          "number": 3,
          "phase": "allow",
          "action": "Allow a request when at least one applicable matching rule grants it.",
          "heldState": "Store matched-grant explanation, not a guessed generic role label."

        {
          "number": 4,
          "phase": "deny",
          "action": "For secrets get, no rule matches; all demo authorizers have no opinion and overall request is denied.",

      "id": "K8S09",

        "API TokenRequest issuer",
        "Workload"

    {
      "id": "MCP01",
      "title": "Remote MCP: discovery to authorized tool result",
      "scope": "Core MCP 2026-07-28 HTTP authorization teaching profile; authorization itself is optional for MCP deployments. No deprecated session or DCR default.",
      "deliveryScope": "core",
      "goal": "Follow one complete human-delegated request, identifying who issues the token and who finally decides to run the tool.",
      "actors": [
        "Host / MCP client C",
        "User and browser B",
        "Protected MCP resource R",
        "Authorization server A"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "MCP 2026-07-28 over HTTPS Streamable HTTP; canonical resource https://mcp.lab.example/team/mcp.",
        "Public desktop client is already registered at A; redirect is an approved loopback callback, no embedded client secret.",
        "A advertises S256; lab scope files:read is illustrative, not a standardized MCP-wide scope."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "C sends a self-contained tools/list POST with correct current-version metadata but no token; R returns 401 with Bearer resource_metadata and files:read guidance.",
        "C obtains and validates resource metadata, selects A, then separately obtains validated A metadata. Label discovery as configuration discovery, not authentication success.",
        "C creates per-attempt state, verifier and S256 challenge; B carries the authorization request with resource and requested scope to A.",
        "A performs its chosen user authentication and consent; depict those as A-owned local/interaction steps, not an MCP password exchange.",
        "B returns a short-lived code. C checks transaction/issuer/redirect binding, then sends grant_type=authorization_code, client_id, code, verifier and resource to the recorded token endpoint.",
        "After A validates the grant, C acquires an access token; C sends it in Authorization on the retried POST.",
        "R separately recovers, validates and authorizes the request; then returns a tool list. A later approved read tool call returns a result only after its own policy decision."
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        "User cancels consent: no token or tool execution.",
        "Missing token on a later POST: challenge again; an earlier successful request grants no connection-wide authority.",
        "No advertised PKCE capability: stop before opening the authorization flow."
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "Show token receipt before R validation and validation before tool execution.",
        "Verifier never appears in browser authorization parameters or at R.",
        "Resource parameter is visible on both authorization and token requests; access token is absent from URLs.",
        "Full and filtered replay converge on the same accepted-result state."
      ],
      "sources": [
        "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/2026-07-28/tutorials/security/authorization",
        "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization",
        "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9728.html",
        "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8707.html",
        "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7636.html",
        "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6750.html",
        "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http"

    {
      "id": "MCP02",
      "title": "Discover the correct resource and authorization server",
      "scope": "Core MCP 2026-07-28 HTTP authorization teaching profile; authorization itself is optional for MCP deployments. No deprecated session or DCR default.",
      "deliveryScope": "core",
      "goal": "Make challenge precedence, path-aware discovery and issuer-isolated credentials observable before any secret is sent.",
      "actors": [
        "MCP client C",
        "Protected resource R",
        "Authorization servers A and A2"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Resource path is /team/mcp; authorization issuer is https://login.lab.example/tenant-a.",
        "Two metadata variants: explicit challenge pointer; no pointer with well-known fallback.",
        "A2 is a separately configured issuer, not an alias of A."
      ],
      "steps": [

    {
      "id": "MCP13",
      "title": "Local stdio: process credentials and OS authority",
      "scope": "Core stdio transport, outside the MCP HTTP OAuth authorization mechanism. Environment/secret-provider and OS policy are declared local deployment behavior.",
      "deliveryScope": "core",
      "goal": "Explain why local subprocess access follows process/credential boundaries rather than the remote HTTP OAuth challenge.",
      "actors": [
        "Host C",
        "Local MCP subprocess S",
        "OS credential store / launcher O",
        "Optional upstream API U"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "MCP 2026-07-28 stdio transport; a restricted synthetic process profile.",
        "S receives only its configured credential via its declared launcher/secret-provider path.",
        "No real subprocess, OS secret or network access is performed by the simulator."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "C launches the modeled subprocess under the selected OS identity and restricted environment.",
        "O supplies the per-server credential; label the provider action and resulting local possession.",
        "C and S exchange newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout; do not insert an HTTP 401/WWW-Authenticate flow.",
        "S attempts a local resource action under OS policy or uses its separately obtained upstream credential.",
        "An OS/resource policy decision determines the operation result; MCP transport alone does not sandbox S.",
        "On termination show the modeled credential cleanup separately from upstream token validity/revocation."
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        "Missing environment/secret-provider value; OS file denial; missing upstream scope.",
        "A global inherited credential would be overbroad; use a visible bad-configuration fixture, not the default.",
        "HTTP-to-stdio proxy would introduce a remote boundary requiring its own declared protection.",
        "MCP roots or tool approval are not an OS containment guarantee."
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "No browser authorization grant appears unless a separately selected upstream library actually uses one.",
        "Local identity, token authority and allowed file access stay independent.",
        "Cross-link workstation/PAM/LSM material instead of inventing platform behavior here.",
        "Diagnostics never print environment values or inherited real file paths."
      ],
      "sources": [
        "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/stdio",
        "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/2026-07-28/tutorials/security/local-server-security",
        "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization"
      ],
      "optional": false,
      "implementationPhase": "P5",
      "workspace": "mcp",
      "proposedRuntimeId": "lab-mcp13"
    },
    {
      "id": "MCP14",
      "title": "Optional machine client: client-credentials extension",
      "scope": "Optional io.modelcontextprotocol/oauth-client-credentials extension, explicitly enabled and version/snapshot-pinned; not a core mandatory user authorization flow.",
      "deliveryScope": "optional",
      "goal": "Show an application obtaining its own authorization without pretending to be an interactively authenticated user.",
      "actors": [
        "Confidential machine client C",
        "Authorization server A",
        "MCP resource R"
      ],
      "preconditions": [
        "Explicitly enabled io.modelcontextprotocol/oauth-client-credentials extension and compatible client/server policy.",
        "Pre-registered confidential client; choose private_key_jwt authentication or a secret-based comparison.",
        "Current extension source must be pinned by snapshot/hash at implementation freeze; no made-up extension version."
      ],
      "steps": [
        "C declares extension support through the current per-request capabilities profile.",
        "C creates a short-lived signed client assertion, or selects its securely configured secret-based authentication method.",
        "C requests grant_type=client_credentials with the intended resource and application scopes at A.",
        "A validates client authentication and application policy, then issues an access token for R.",
        "C sends a version-correct authenticated POST; R validates the token and authorizes the machine operation.",
        "At expiry, C obtains another client-credentials token; do not fabricate a browser or assume refresh_token grant support."
      ],
      "negativeCases": [
        "Extension unsupported or policy disallows machine access.",
        "Bad assertion signature/audience/expiry, reused jti under the selected replay-protection profile, or invalid secret.",
        "Valid client authentication but requested application scope denied.",
        "Machine token must not inherit a human subject or an existing user consent record."
      ],
      "acceptance": [
        "JWT assertion, private key and resulting access token have separate identities and holder permissions.",
        "Private signing key never leaves C; assertion is delivered to A, not used as R bearer token.",
        "No mandatory-core label, interactive consent event or guaranteed refresh token.",
        "Cross-link JWT client-assertion validation; do not mislabel client authentication as JWT bearer authorization grant."
      ],
      "sources": [
        "https://modelcontextprotocol.io/extensions/auth/oauth-client-credentials",
        "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6749.html#section-4.4",
        "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7523.html",
        "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8707.html",
        "https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6750.html"
      ],
      "optional": true,
      "implementationPhase": "P5",
      "workspace": "mcp",
      "proposedRuntimeId": "lab-mcp14"
    }
  ],

                  "resourceRules": [

                    "message": "demo ConfigMaps require training=approved"

                ],
                "matchResources": {

        {
          "id": "projected-workload",
          "classification": "core scenario extension",
          "scenarioIds": [
            "K8S09",
            "K8S12"
          ],
          "instructions": "Worker builds the local demo reader image and pins its digest for any live run. The example is deliberately not a downloadable third-party workload. Explicit projection still works with automatic mounting disabled. For API TLS, provide trusted CA separately; never skip server verification.",
          "objects": [
            {
              "apiVersion": "v1",
              "kind": "Pod",
              "metadata": {
                "name": "demo-reader",
                "namespace": "demo-dev"
              },
              "spec": {
                "serviceAccountName": "reader",
                "automountServiceAccountToken": false,
                "containers": [
                  {
                    "name": "reader",
                    "image": "authflow-reader:local",
                    "imagePullPolicy": "Never",
                    "volumeMounts": [
                      {
                        "name": "identity",
                        "mountPath": "/var/run/demo-identity",
                        "readOnly": true
                      }
                    ]
                  }
                ],
                "volumes": [
                  {
                    "name": "identity",
                    "projected": {
                      "sources": [
                        {
                          "serviceAccountToken": {
                            "path": "api-token",
                            "audience": "https://kubernetes.demo.example",
                            "expirationSeconds": 3600
                          }
                        },
                        {
                          "serviceAccountToken": {
                            "path": "vault-token",
                            "audience": "vault.demo.example",
                            "expirationSeconds": 3600
                          }
                        }
                      ]
                    }
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        },

        {
          "id": "core-api-configuration",
          "classification": "core",
          "scenarioIds": [
            "K8S01",
            "K8S02",
            "K8S09"
          ],
          "configurationFiles": {
            "authentication.yaml": {
              "apiVersion": "apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1",
              "kind": "AuthenticationConfiguration",
              "anonymous": {
                "enabled": false
              },
              "jwt": [
                {
                  "issuer": {
                    "url": "https://issuer.demo.example",
                    "audiences": [
                      "kubernetes-demo"
                    ],
                    "audienceMatchPolicy": "MatchAny"
                  },
                  "claimValidationRules": [
                    {
                      "claim": "tenant",
                      "requiredValue": "demo"
                    }
                  ],
                  "claimMappings": {
                    "username": {
                      "claim": "sub",
                      "prefix": "oidc:"
                    },
                    "groups": {
                      "claim": "groups",
                      "prefix": "team:"
                    }
                  },
                  "userValidationRules": [
                    {
                      "expression": "!user.username.startsWith('system:')",
                      "message": "human username must not use a system prefix"
                    },
                    {
                      "expression": "user.groups.all(group, !group.startsWith('system:'))",
                      "message": "mapped human groups must not use a system prefix"
                    }
                  ]
                }
              ]
            },
            "authorization.yaml": {
              "apiVersion": "apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1",
              "kind": "AuthorizationConfiguration",
              "authorizers": [
                {
                  "type": "Node",
                  "name": "node"
                },
                {
                  "type": "RBAC",
                  "name": "rbac"
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          "arguments": [
            "--authentication-config=/etc/demo/authentication.yaml",
            "--authorization-config=/etc/demo/authorization.yaml",
            "--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.demo.example",
            "--api-audiences=https://kubernetes.demo.example",
            "--service-account-signing-key-file=/etc/demo/sa-signing.key",
            "--service-account-key-file=/etc/demo/sa-verification.pub",
            "--service-account-extend-token-expiration=false"
          ],
          "instructions": "Partial API-server security configuration, not a complete cluster bootstrap command. Add independently provisioned TLS, etcd and node credentials. Signing private key remains server-local. No --oidc-* or --anonymous-auth flags with this authentication file; no --authorization-mode with this authorization file."
        },

    "profile": {
      "researchDate": "2026-10-21",
      "selectedKubernetes": "v1.37.1; confirmed published stable patch through official release page and release tag; not a claim that it is the newest available patch",
      "releaseCaveat": "The release page lists v1.37.2 with a 2026-10-13 target under Upcoming Patch. A passed target date is not proof of release. Before implementation freeze, record tag/commit or image digest and source revision; do not silently change this profile.",
      "maturity": [
        "AuthenticationConfiguration and configurable anonymous endpoints: stable since v1.34.",
        "client-go exec credential plugins: stable since v1.22; use ExecCredential v1.",
        "ValidatingAdmissionPolicy: stable since v1.30; K8S08 uses admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1.",
        "AuthorizationConfiguration: stable since v1.32.",
        "ServiceAccount token volume projection: stable since v1.20; bound-token default volume mechanism: stable since v1.22. Keep these distinct feature names.",
        "SelfSubjectReview: stable since v1.28.",
        "Constrained impersonation: beta since v1.36, enabled by default in current docs; label and record gate state separately.",
        "StructuredAuthenticationConfigurationEgressSelector is beta in current docs; not needed by default demo.",
        "APIServerWebhookAuthenticationToken is alpha in v1.37; excluded from default profile."
      ],
      "sourceDiscrepancies": [
        "Authentication page repeats --oidc-signing-algs with inconsistent default values (RS256 in its OIDC table and RS512 later). Do not rely on either prose default: explicit RS256 for an optional flag-only profile and pinned-source verification. AuthenticationConfiguration v1 has no signingAlgs field; do not invent one.",
        "Current documentation is moving. Archive consulted sections or tag the implementation evidence. Distinguish chosen teaching policy from Kubernetes implementation defaults."
      ]
    },

              "get",

              "watch"
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      "roleBinding": {
        "apiVersion": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1",
        "kind": "RoleBinding",
        "metadata": {
          "name": "read-pods",
          "namespace": "demo-dev"
        },
        "subjects": [
          {
            "kind": "Group",
            "name": "team:readers",
            "apiGroup": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io"
          }
        ],
        "roleRef": {
          "kind": "Role",
          "name": "reader",
          "apiGroup": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io"
        }
      },
      "serviceAccount": "demo-dev/reader, UID sa-1; explicit additional ServiceAccount RoleBinding exists only in its success variant.",
      "policyIsolation": "Each scenario begins from named resettable policy snapshot. Bob starts denied. A label is never presented as an authorization rule by itself.",
      "authenticationConfigExample": {
        "apiVersion": "apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1",
        "kind": "AuthenticationConfiguration",
        "anonymous": {
          "enabled": false
        },
        "jwt": [
          {
            "issuer": {
              "url": "https://issuer.demo.example",
              "audiences": [
                "kubernetes-demo"
              ],
              "audienceMatchPolicy": "MatchAny"
            },
            "claimValidationRules": [
              {
                "claim": "tenant",
                "requiredValue": "demo"
              }
            ],
            "claimMappings": {
              "username": {
                "claim": "sub",
                "prefix": "oidc:"
              },
              "groups": {
                "claim": "groups",
                "prefix": "team:"
              }
            },
            "userValidationRules": [
              {
                "expression": "!user.username.startsWith('system:')",
                "message": "human username must not use a system prefix"
              },
              {
                "expression": "user.groups.all(group, !group.startsWith('system:'))",
                "message": "mapped human groups must not use a system prefix"
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      },
      "configCaveat": "API server adds system:authenticated after external mapping; validation example constrains mapped issuer groups. Worker must validate exact v1 schema and evaluation order against selected tag before presenting runnable YAML. No --oidc-* arguments may be combined with --authentication-config."
    },
    "globalRequirements": [
      "Create a dedicated Kubernetes navigation/workspace group with Human access, Token validation, Authorization/RBAC, Workload identity, and Delegation/extensions families. JWT foundations are their own shared family linked from K8s and existing OAuth/OIDC/JWE lessons. Do not bury Kubernetes inside generic OAuth or silently duplicate existing lessons.",
      "Use canonical events, explicit actor-local holdings and immutable artifact/generation IDs. Track received bytes, parsed untrusted claims, verified signature, validated claims, mapped userInfo, authorization input/verdict, admission proposal/verdict, persisted object and response separately. Reading a claim never creates permission.",
      "Model API authentication/RBAC/admission as local API-server stages; different swimlanes may explain responsibilities but must not fabricate network hops. The API server may read from watch caches; a symbolic storage boundary must not imply every read makes a new etcd network RPC.",
      "Each scenario has a fixed happy path and independently selectable failures with declared policy. Branches must alter the relevant request/claim/key/rule/state, not only the narration. Do not silently recover into another authenticator or grant.",
      "JWT validation requires primary-source rules and profile-specific requirements. Public key retrieval is not proof of trust by itself. Never expose issuer private keys, refresh tokens or plaintext JWE contents to actors that do not possess them. Bearer token display is synthetic and clearly labeled.",
      "Maintain overview/field/exact-object replay parity. Exact history must retain token envelope versus decrypted/validated representation, principal origin, binding rule and namespace; backwards seek must rebuild state deterministically and clear stale grants/results.",
      "Provide a visible decision strip: credential → identity → requested action → matching grant → admission when relevant → result. Show why a step is skipped. Error cards name failing stage, caller identity, actual status and next meaningful action; do not map all 403s to RBAC.",
      "Navigation, source/profile expanders and scenario switches need keyboard focus return, readable 390px layout, no token overflow, accessible branch labels and no color-only success signal. Keep five or fewer actors horizontally; break browser/login and API authorization into linked phases without losing artifacts.",
      "Source panel pins release/profile/feature maturity, RFC section or Kubernetes section, retrieval date, implementation-specific cache policy and limits. Mark symbolic fixtures as symbolic; cryptographic validity requires separately computed test vectors rather than decorative signatures.",
      "Tests should prove state boundaries and failure behavior, not mirror prose. Test route registration, all declared scenario IDs, preservation of existing OIDC/JWT/JWE paths, policy reset, identity mapping, exact-request RBAC decisions, JWT/key/token rotation, representation custody, no post-rejection persistence, and actual mounted field-to-exact-history transitions.",
      "Before claiming runnable Kubernetes conformance, validate config/manifests and critical status/feature behavior against pinned v1.37.1 executable or source. Native-browser evidence remains separate from DOM tests and from live Kubernetes interoperability. Report any source discrepancy instead of inventing a consensus."
    ],

WIN-11 accepted within its stated scope

Auth Flow Studio · acceptor-subkey field history · reviewer-to-worker handoff

No blocking defect found in this change. The thirteen intended CredSSP/RDP profiles now begin the acceptor-key field history at H’s local creation. Existing wire data, canonical custody and client validation boundaries are preserved. This accepts WIN-11; it does not mark every key-origin history or the next expansion plan complete.
